reference_scope.adult_generation: explicitly adult independently chosen; reference does not prove age
used: visible dark bob and wispy fringe

test_gates.connection: upper garment occupies shoulders, sleeves and torso above chima
test_gates.pass: Distinct short jacket with sleeves and crossing front above lower skirt.
test_gates.partial: Jacket-like form exists but upper/lower boundary is unreadable.
test_gates.fail: Continuous dress, misplaced separate scarf, or missing upper jacket.
test_gates.alternative_misread: An undifferentiated robe or shirt without jacket boundary.

test_gates.connection: white strip follows the overlapping collar line
test_gates.pass: White collar strip visibly attached along both sides of jeogori neckline.
test_gates.partial: A white area appears but cannot be separated from undershirt or neckline fill.
test_gates.fail: Missing strip or detached white necklace/lining mistaken for collar.

test_gates.connection: ribbons emerge from upper garment and are tied at chest
test_gates.pass: Readable garment-attached ribbon knot or loop and two tails at the chest.
test_gates.partial: Ribbons visible but attachment/tie or separate tails ambiguous.
test_gates.fail: Belt, necktie, independent scarf, or missing tie.

test_gates.connection: suspension cord from garment knot descends through ornament to tassel
test_gates.pass: Garment attachment, cord/knot, pendant and tassel appear as one connected hanging ornament.
test_gates.partial: Ornament appears but attachment, knot or chain is occluded/indistinct.
test_gates.fail: Floating pendant, hair ornament, neck necklace, or missing pendant/tassel chain.

test_gates.connection: skirt starts at high waist under jacket and falls in broad folds
test_gates.pass: High-waisted skirt with continuous broad drape and vertical pleats below jeogori.
test_gates.partial: Lower drape exists but waist ownership or skirt form is unclear.
test_gates.fail: Trousers, detached cape, or missing lower skirt.

test_gates.connection: jeogori hem lies over chima high waist
test_gates.pass: Visible upper hem edge occludes skirt waistband/top with a distinct overlap or shadow boundary.
test_gates.partial: Different colors suggest two pieces but junction does not establish order.
test_gates.fail: Reversed order or merged continuous garment.

test_gates.connection: continuous metal rim retains the stone around its perimeter
test_gates.pass: Pale-green stone visibly surrounded and held by continuous silver metal rim.
test_gates.partial: Stone and rim exist but continuity/retention is unresolved at native scale.
test_gates.fail: Prongs, floating stone, painted silver edge or absent stone.
test_gates.alternative_misread: Prong mounting or flat decorative silver outline.

test_gates.connection: separate metal loop bridges suspension cord to pendant body
test_gates.pass: Distinct upper metal bail with visible connection to cord and pendant.
test_gates.partial: Small metallic connection is present but loop/bridge cannot be read.
test_gates.fail: Direct cord drilled through pendant, disconnected ornament, or absent bail.
test_gates.alternative_misread: Decorative knot or the bezel rim itself.

shared_physical_gates.pass: Visible arms and hands connect to the main subject with plausible anatomy.
Standing body has plausible balance; held case and garment ornament are supported by their declared owners.
Left hand grips case handle; ornament cord/pendant/bail connections appear physically joined.
All eight keyword gates can be directly judged at native resolution with necessary junctions in frame.

overall_rule: All gates must be PASS; PARTIAL is overall FAIL. Prompt/runtime passes are separate from pixel success and user acceptance.
